text:
jordan: deploy-bot just put ms-inventory canary on HOLD — ingress-subchart image tag mismatch between chart lock and values (subchart.image.tag=stable vs parent override=canary-20260320). anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: canary health=degraded · preflight failed: values-image-tag-mismatch detected for subchart 'ingress'. blocked by chart-version check. suggested actions: pin subchart to 1.4.2 or apply values hotpatch.

maya: on it, checking helm values + Chart.lock :eyes: looks like parent chart sets ingress.image.tag at top-level, subchart defaults differ.

samir: if we pin subchart we'll need a hotfix release note. change window ends in 45m — prefer a patch over a rollback unless there's a migration.

jordan: agree, avoid full rollback if possible. what's risk of patching values during canary?

maya: low risk — ingress sidecar only. plan: open a values hotfix PR, apply a manual values override to the canary namespace, then re-run canary smoke checks. command I'll run: `helm upgrade ms-inventory ./charts/ms-inventory --values values-prod.yaml --set ingress.image.tag=canary-20260320 --namespace prod-canary --wait`.

julie: can we use deploy-bot hotpatch path so it's auditable? deploy-bot, accept manual override?

deploy-bot: manual_values_override requested by maya. ops-oncall approved. applying override to canary namespace now. automated command record: ```helm upgrade ms-inventory ./charts/ms-inventory --values values-prod.yaml --set ingress.image.tag=canary-20260320 --namespace prod-canary --wait```

maya: running helm upgrade and tailing logs, will post kubectl rollout status once pods replaced.

julie: also add release note: "ms-inventory: fix ingress sidecar tag mismatch during canary; hotpatch applied, no rollback" — I'll add to the draft notes and link PR after we confirm.

jordan: once canary stable for 10m promote to staged. samir take release notes + bump chart lock?

samir: taking it. creating PR to bump subchart lock to 1.4.2 and adding release note bullet: https://git.redwood/infra/ms-inventory/pull/432

ops-bot: canary health OK after override. monitoring window: 15m.

maya: 15m passed, metrics look normal :thumbsup:. proceeding to trigger deploy-bot rollout for staged -> stable.

deploy-bot: queued full rollout (canary->staged->stable) per override ticket. estimated start in ~3m. audit id: deploy-2150006789-override.

jordan: thanks all. we kept parent chart version unchanged; follow-up action to align subchart semver with parent and add a preflight check to detect tag drift. filed INFRA-1256 for postmortem/action items.

julie: :memo: Release notes updated and linked to PR. postmortem optional but capturing steps in ticket and incident log.

(attachments: helm command snippet, PR link, ticket INFRA-1256)
